query: I was walking my golden retriever puppy this morning and he stopped to sniff a whole patch of wild clover by the sidewalk, he even tried to nibble a little white flower off one of the stems before I could stop him. Then on my way home I popped into the corner café and got a lavender honey latte that was perfectly foamy on top, the barista even drew a little heart in the foam this time. I just got home and realized something's off with my phone, so I wanted to reach out for help. My airplane mode is turned on right now, and I need to break both permissions for this app I have installed.
